title: Among promotional cards that are legal in the Commander format and have no
question: Among promotional cards that are legal in the Commander format and have no content warning, find the artist who illustrated the most such cards that also have non-null cardKingdomId and cardKingdomFoilId. Return the artist name and the count of these cards.

prediction.sql:
SELECT c.XCL_002 AS artist, COUNT(c.XCL_001) AS card_count
FROM cards c
INNER JOIN legalities l ON c.XCL_072 = l.XCL_086
WHERE c.XCL_004 = 'promotional'
  AND l.XCL_084 = 'commander'
  AND l.XCL_085 = 'Legal'
  AND c.XCL_064 IS NULL
  AND c.XCL_006 IS NOT NULL
  AND c.XCL_007 IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.XCL_002
ORDER BY card_count DESC
LIMIT 1
